bullets.text: Windows Update Experience Enhanced - **Microsoft** introduces new controls for users to manage updates more effectively.
New Experimental Channels Launched - Transition to **Experimental** and **Beta** channels begins for Windows Insiders.
GPT-5.5 Now Available - **OpenAI's** latest model is integrated into **Microsoft Foundry** for enterprise applications.
LangChain.js Course Released - A free course to build agentic AI apps using **JavaScript** is now available.
Windows 365 Link Celebrates Year - **Microsoft's** cloud PC device marks a successful year in simplifying IT management.
AI-Powered Cyber Defense - **Microsoft** emphasizes AI's role in enhancing cybersecurity against evolving threats.
Azure Accelerate for Databases - New offering helps organizations modernize databases for AI readiness.
Agentic AI Advancements - **Microsoft Discovery** expands access to enhance R&D capabilities with agentic AI.
Secure Passkey Sync Introduced - **Microsoft Password Manager** now allows secure syncing of passkeys across devices.
